paragraphs.text: Torbran , Thane of Red Fell is a Dwarf Noble from Eldraine .
Torbran is a red-bearded dwarf who wields a massive axe. He briefly wore a glowing, golden wishing ring.

The majority of dwarves are put off by the hierarchy and stuffiness of the human courts and prefer to live out in the wilds. For a few individual dwarves, the fearless camaraderie of the Court of Embereth appeals to them. These dwarves, driven by the independence so valued by their clans, sometimes pack up for a few years to compete at the Burning Yard , often bringing with them dwarf-forged armor and weapons that give them an edge in combat.

One such dwarf was Torbran, the current Thane of the dwarvish clan of Red Fell . As the story goes, Torbran traveled to Embereth in his youth to compete for knighthood . Though he defeated each foe he faced, when the time came to claim his prize and strike the Irencrag , Torbran refused. According to him, the Irencrag had insulted the craftsmanship of his weapon in its taunts (which would be quite a personal offense in dwarvish culture). Unwilling to give the stone the satisfaction of tasting his blade, Torbran left Embereth and returned to the Wilds . Some in Embereth consider Torbran a coward for leaving, but many others believe that Torbran will one day return to claim his rightful knighthood. They believe he has spent the past few decades crafting a weapon of such quality and power that it will strike fear into the Irencrag itself.

When New Phyrexia invaded Eldraine, Torbran escaped compleation and planned an attack on the Phyrexianized Castle Locthwain . While traveling there, he rescued Rankle from a Phyrexian attack, and took him along, not knowing that the faerie was in love with the now- compleat Ayara . He tried and failed to impress the gravity of the situation on Rankle, who was mostly interested in stealing Torbran's things.

When the time came for an attack, Rankle stole Torbran's wishing ring and wasted the first two wishes to spite him. But miraculously, Rankle's third wish - a rain of love potion - ended up singlehandedly defeating the Phyrexian force, which followed Rankle over a cliff to their deaths. Torbran is sure to mourn his fallen ally for the rest of his days.
